nl: 部门管理：查询部门名称；表格展示部门名称、负责人；部门是树形结构（子部门嵌套在父部门下），默认全部展开；支持新增、编辑、删除。
nlEn: Department management: query by department name; the table shows department name and leader; departments are hierarchical (sub-departments nested under their parents) and all nodes start expanded; supports add, edit and delete.
